definitions.explanation: The amount of time spent waiting for something, such as at a restaurant, hospital, or attraction.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}は30{分|ぷん}です。
{人気|にんき}のレストランは{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}が{長|なが}い。
examples.english: Popular restaurants have long wait times.

examples.japanese: アプリで{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}を{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: You can check the wait time on the app.

notes:
{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん} is a compound noun: {待|ま}ち (waiting, from {待|ま}つ) + {時間|じかん} (time). It refers to the time spent waiting before being served or admitted.

USAGE:
- {病院|びょういん}の{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: hospital waiting time
- {遊園地|ゆうえんち}の{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: theme park queue time
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}の{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: restaurant wait time
- {空港|くうこう}での{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: airport wait/layover time

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}が{長|なが}い: the wait is long
- {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する: to shorten wait times
- {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}{約|やく}〜{分|ふん}: approximately ~ minutes wait

RELATED WORDS:
- {待|ま}ち{列|れつ}: waiting line, queue
- {順番待|じゅんばんま}ち: waiting for one's turn
- {待合室|まちあいしつ}: waiting room
